options: to cause mischief, be up to no good
quiz.answer: to cause mischief, be up to no good

quiz.prompt: Is Unwesen used outside the idiom?

goodToKnow: Das Unwesen is mischief or nuisance and appears almost only in sein Unwesen treiben: to be up to no good, to make trouble or to haunt. Taschendiebe, Betrüger, Hacker or Geister treiben ihr Unwesen. Das Wesen means being, creature or nature: ein seltsames Wesen. The un- here means bad, as in das Unwetter (severe storm). It has no plural.
